ASMR

Old guy here ... don't hit me, but what is ASMR ... looked it up, of course, but still don't get it. Not knocking whatever, don't take this negatively, not meant to be ... but clarify a bit, if ya would.

No worries. It stands for Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response. It's bassically just a head tingly sensation to certain sounds/situations. Could be as simple as the personal attention from a doctor, facepainting, or such and such. Or it's sounds; soft voices, crinkly soinds, tapping, and so on.

So the community is basically a bunch of people who experienced this but felt like they were the only one. So now people create videos with high-quality audio to try and recreate the sounds or situations that cause that reaction. It can get Pretty weird... But it's relaxing.
Cool, thanks for the explanation. Again, as an old guy, I can give ya the hippy take on such things (though I was never really a hippy, per se) ... 'whatever floats your boat, man!'
